name: Paladin · Knight style A (Classic)
description: Dame Seraphine redrawn in the plumed Knight’s style: a white veil over a gold circlet with a holy gem, falling down her back and swaying in her breathing idle, streaming on the walk and flung back by the blow, as the Knight’s plume and cape do; silver plate with hue-shifted blue-violet shadows and warm cream lights, a white tabard with a gold sun, a gold belt and a tabard skirt that swings with the stride; a small 3/4 face under the veil. She holds her warhammer upright at her side. Smite: she gathers light at her chest, heaves the hammer up behind her head, brings it over the top in a blazing gold-white arc and slams it down in front of her (frame 19): a flash, rays, a ground flare and a pillar of holy light to the sky, which thins into rising sparks as she lifts the hammer back. No black outline: every edge is a dark tone of its own material. The holy light, the circlet gem and the sun’s heart glow.
